Name.description: Link to the reified Name collection.

Identifier.description: Link to the reified Identifier collection.

Equivalent.description: This field is used to document a URI which is meant to indicate an equivalence between the documented physical thing and a resolvable, structured reference resource that stands as a document for this self same entity.

Type.description: Link to the reified Type collection.

Material.description: This field is used to record the material of which the documented physical thing consists.

Production.description: Link to the reified Production collection.

Destruction.description: Link to the reified Destruction collection.

Permanent Location.description: This field is used to link the documented physical thing with the instance of place that stands as its permanent location.

Part of Object.description: This field is used to link the documented instance of physical thing to another instance of physical thing of which it forms a part.

Visual Image Shown.description: This field is used to link the documented physical thing to an instance of visual work that it shows.

Statement.description: Link to the reified Statement collection.

Rights.description: Link to the reified Rights collection.

Current Custodian.description: This field is used to link the documented physical thing with an instance of person or group that is its present custodian.

Current Owner.description: This field is used to link the documented physical thing with an instance of person or group that is its present owner.

Depicting Image.description: This field  is used to record the existence of an image which depicts the documented physical thing.

Digital Reference.description: Link to the reified Digital Reference collection.

Source Reference Work.description: This field is used to link the documented physical thing to an instance of textual work which describes or documents it.

Condition State.description: This field is used to indicate a condition state type that has been attributed to the documented hardware.

Custodial Status.description: Link to the reified Custodial Status collection.
